newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intl Network started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intl Network started.

text.p: -- Robertson Stephens & Co said its analyst Cathy Baker started coverage of International Network Services with long-term attractive rating.

-- The company provides computer network infrastructure and network services to customers. Baker estimates its market as growing 40 percent or more annually. Baker believes it can earn $0.20 a share in 1997 and $0.38 a share in 1998.
-- International Network completed its initial public offering of common stock in September. The shares, priced at $16.00 each, rose 13-1/2 points on their first day.
-- The stock was up 2-1/2 to 37-1/2 by midday Monday.
